understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to place every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. If there were multiple goals, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to be won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces could be selected by clicking their positions and moved with directional actions or valid clicks. Walls and obstacles blocked movement, and invalid clicks left the selected piece unchanged. Pieces could interact with obstacles through pushing when the path and destination allowed it; selection changed only when clicking a valid selectable piece or reachable target.
